in_sanskrit.name: यमिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess Yamuna, Yama's consort or daughter

in_marathi.name: Yamika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Yamuna's name
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yamika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the name of the Goddess Yamuna, who is a major tributary in India and is considered the sister of the God Yama, the God of Death. She is also believed to represent the goddess of fertility, nourishment, and purity.

She is also believed to represent the goddess of fertility, nourishment, and purity.
